lines.gist: State the massive per-night revenue of the Eras Tour.
Explain how all tour dates were completely sold out.
Highlight the massive total stadium audience attendance globally.
Calculate the average ticket price per seat across all concerts.
Set up the total gross calculation after 21 active months.
Clarify that the figure excludes merchandise and album revenue streams.

whyItWorks: Starts with a high-impact per-night dollar figure immediately on screen and voiced in second one.
Uses clean vector graphic animations and stacked objects to make large numeric concepts easy to digest.
Excludes merch and salary to build anticipation for the final billion-dollar ticket box office reveal.
Concludes with an engaging question that doubles as a seamless video loop trigger.
